name: Portuguese match page translates data labels, not just nav
description: A half-translated page localizes static nav but leaves data-area labels (tab names like Lineups/Analysis/Odds, table headers, status pills) in English. On /pt/match/<id> the content-area labels must read in Portuguese, differing from the same labels on /en/match/<id>. The test judges that the language changed rather than matching a fixed translation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Navigate to /en/match/<captured-id> and read the content-area tab names, table headers and status pill text
Navigate to /pt/match/<captured-id> and read the same content-area tab names, table headers and status pill text

Verify the Portuguese match page's data-area labels (tabs such as Lineups/Analysis/Odds, table headers, status pills) differ from the English ones and read as Portuguese. If the data labels remain in English while only the nav is translated, the test fails.
